mapper.select: SELECT m1.conversation_id FROM tab_chat_conversation_member m1 INNER JOIN tab_chat_conversation_member m2 ON m1.conversation_id = m2.conversation_id INNER JOIN tab_chat_conversation c ON c.id = m1.conversation_id WHERE m1.user_id = #{userId1} AND m2.user_id = #{userId2} AND c.conversation_type = 1 LIMIT 1
